The probe reproduces the sweep: Tab reaches the timeline's scroll-left button and it measures invisible. The button is at opacity 0 even while focused, so its focus ring is invisible too, and it has no name. It still works (Enter scrolled the timeline left by 115px, then Space by another 115px), so a sighted keyboard user operates a control they cannot see. It is one stop outside the main task path, so it stays medium.

The rect is a transparent overlay (fill transparent) over the plot area of the Cash in vs out chart, and a click on it opens the side panel for the month under the pointer. The four monthly bars in the same chart are buttons with tabindex 0 that the Tab walk reaches, and Enter on the August bar opened the same panel, so a keyboard user can do everything the click does.
criterionAnalysis: 2.1.1 needs all functionality to work from a keyboard. Opening a month's report details is available from the keyboard: each month's bar is a focusable button labelled with its figures and 'Press Enter or Space to view report details', and Enter opens the same panel the overlay click opens. The overlay only carries the pointer hover and click, so no keyboard function is missing. 2.4.7 and 4.1.2 are not at issue for an element that carries no keyboard function of its own.
